# foundry_connection (Data Source)

Reads a connection in the Foundry project. Connections are created and managed in Azure Resource Manager, for example with the AzureRM provider, because the Foundry API exposes them as read-only. Use this data source to reference an existing connection from a toolbox tool's `project_connection_id`.

Credentials are never returned by this data source.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the connection.

### Read-Only

- `credential_type` (String) Kind of credential the connection uses, such as `ApiKey`, `AAD`, `SAS`, or `None`. The credential itself is not returned.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the connection, used as `project_connection_id` on tools that reference it.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this connection is the project's default connection for its type.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Metadata recorded on the connection.
- `target` (String) URL of the service this connection points to.
- `type` (String) Category of the connection, such as `CognitiveSearch`, `AzureOpenAI`, `CustomKeys`, or `ApiKey`.
